people.name: Cyprus
people.line: Island in the Mediterranean Sea; early Christian community

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

people.name: Tyre
people.line: A major Phoenician port city, known for its trade

translations.web: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.
translations.bsb: After sighting Cyprus and passing south of it, we sailed on to Syria and landed at Tyre, where the ship was to unload its cargo.
translations.kjv: Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.
translations.asv: And when we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed unto Syria, and landed at Tyre; for there the ship was to unlade her burden.
